title: A `throw` of an anonymous object compiles, and no `catch` sees it.
text: `throw {class: "X", message: "m"};` passes `nvs check`, and so does a `throw` of a parameter typed with a shape, such as the `error` field of a `spawn script` result. When it runs, `catch (Throwable $t)` does not catch it. `finally` runs, and the program ends with exit 1 and a report with an empty message and the class `$shape{class,message}`. A class that is not `Throwable` is `E0780`, so the shape skips that check. It closes when a `throw` of any value that is not `Throwable` is `E0780`, with a conformance case.
